data.name: Vilim
data.gender_notes: Vilim is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Protector and Warrior, derived from the old Slavic word ‘vili’, meaning friend or protector, and ‘m’, meaning son of. The name Vilim carries the meaning “Protector, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Vilim usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Vilim belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vilim total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
